mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS decline remains below 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3-month easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle that raises discount rates on equities, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in periods following FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5%, or the tightening effect persists without a decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL remains above 231.8).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and fall in UNRATE below 5.0% amplifies monetary tightening and labor market strength, jointly compressing equity valuations and reducing future returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls <5.0% in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market expansion
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and UNRATE falls <5.0% in the same 3-month period, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Pearson r <0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained fall in UNRATE below 5.0% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE falls below 5.0%, or the correlation between UNRATE decline and returns is weak (Pearson r <0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 98.7% signals robust supply growth, reducing inflationary pressures and lowering risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in periods of sustained INDPRO growth above 98.7%, or the supply growth does not correlate with lower risk premiums (CPIAUCSL remains above 231.8).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 demand and HOUST housing demand both signal robust economic activity, driving corporate earnings growth and investor confidence, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 rises >2% and HOUST rises >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise >2% and >5% respectively in the same 3-month period, or the combined effect is not statistically significant (Pearson r <0.1).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.25% signals an impending soft landing, reducing growth expectations and compressing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in late-cycle periods where FEDFUNDS decline by >0.25% over 3 months, or the soft landing signal is not associated with lower growth expectations (GDPC1 growth <2%).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS employment and fall in UNRATE below 6.0% reflects a robust labor market, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS rises >10,000 and UNRATE falls <6.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move in the specified directions simultaneously, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (Pearson r <0.1).
